attr.title: Professor Layton Curious Village HD
attr.desc: A remaster of the puzzle-adventure classic. Professor Layton and his apprentice Luke arrive in the village of St. Mystere to solve the mystery of the Golden Apple, and find a place where every resident answers a question with a riddle. Over 130 puzzles, hand-drawn art and fully animated cutscenes, rebuilt in HD.
attr.inst:
Purchase Layton: Curious Village in HD on Google Play and install it on an Android device. Install SAI: https://github.com/Aefyr/SAI/releases/tag/4.5 on that device. In SAI, open the Backup tab, find Layton: Curious Village in HD, and export it. The game is a split install, so this produces an APK file containing several APKs rather than a single one. Copy the APK to your computer, rename it to .zip and extract it. 

You only need two of the pieces:
  - "split_config.arm64_v8a.apk" — contains "lib/"
  - "split_InstallAssets.apk" — contains "assets/" (about 580 MB, the bulk of the game)

Extract the "lib" folder from "split_config.arm64_v8a.apk", and the "assets" folder from "split_InstallAssets.apk" (APKs are ordinary zip files, so any archiver opens them).

Copy both folders into "ports/layton1/" so they sit next to "laytonloader". Run Professor Layton and the Curious Village HD.

Check folder structure below if you are confused where to copy the files!
attr.inst_md:
- Purchase Layton: Curious Village in HD on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Level5.LT1REU) and install it on an Android device.
- Install [SAI (Split APKs Installer) 4.5](https://github.com/Aefyr/SAI/releases/tag/4.5) on that device.
- In SAI, open the **Backup** tab, find *Layton: Curious Village in HD*, and export it. The game is a split install, so this produces an `.apk` file containing several APKs rather than a single one.
- Copy the `.apk` to your computer, rename it to `.zip` and extract it. You only need two of the pieces:
  - **`split_config.arm64_v8a.apk`** — contains `lib/`
  - **`split_InstallAssets.apk`** — contains `assets/` (about 580 MB, the bulk of the game)
- Extract the `lib` folder from `split_config.arm64_v8a.apk`, and the `assets` folder from `split_InstallAssets.apk` (APKs are ordinary zip files, so any archiver opens them).
- Copy both folders into `ports/layton1/` so they sit next to `laytonloader`.
- Run Professor Layton and the Curious Village HD.

Check folder structure below if you are confused where to copy the files!
